correctness.rationale: Dividing Fdot=gamma2 Z F/[(a+Z)(b+F)]-g2 F by F, and separately integrating Fdot, yields mean q=g2/gamma2 and mean Fq=(g2/gamma2)mean F, with q=Z/[(a+Z)(b+F)]. Thus mean(Z/(a+Z))=(g2/gamma2)(b+mean F). The exact reciprocal identity for A=a+mean Z and x=Z-mean Z gives (mean Z)/(a+mean Z)-(g2/gamma2)(b+mean F)=a/A² mean[(Z-mean Z)²/(a+Z)] >=0. Vanishing forces constant Z, then scalar autonomous F dynamics forces constant F and phytoplankton P dynamics forces constant P. Positivity makes strict inequality for non-equilibrium cycles. Rational substitution verifies 1/8 and (1+4Fbar)/(1-8Fbar). Independent Fraction algebra checks confirmed the reciprocal defect.

value.rationale: The exact zooplankton variance controls the strict mean relation for every finite-amplitude periodic state regardless of delay, a motivated correction to equilibrium mean balance. The 1/8 fish ceiling alone also follows from evaluating the fish equation at a periodic maximum, so significance is ascribed to the joint exact variance/mean law, not novelty of an elementary pointwise ceiling.

limitations: Necessary for strictly positive homogeneous periodic cycles, no existence, stability, uniqueness or spatially nonconstant solutions.
